The threshold energies are $E_{0,1}=20$ kcal/mol and $E_{0,2}=23$ kcal/mol. Both pathways strictly follow the collision theory model.

At a constant temperature of $500$ K, the rate of formation of product $Y$ is exactly twice the rate of formation of product $Z$. The observed effective activation energy for the overall disappearance of the reactants is defined by $E_{a,eff}=RT^2\dfrac{d(\ln k_{eff})}{dT}$, where $k_{eff}$ is the effective overall rate constant.
